caption:
🇬🇧 UK Daily Briefing | Monday, 23 November 2026

1. 🤝 PM to tell MPs EU deal is a 'choice between a broken status quo or change'
The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "landmark" agreement that could make the next decade "much better".

2. 🏠 Rents in Britain forecast to rise about twice as fast as buying costs
Hamptons predicts rents on newly agreed lets will grow by 14.2%, as shrinking supply pushes up costs for tenants. Renting is expected to rise about twice as fast as buying until at least 2029.

3. 💷 Disability minister to recommend 'fundamental overhaul' of PIP assessments
Sir Stephen Timms says he will recommend major reforms to the personal independence payment (PIP). A report is due to say assessments need a "fundamental overhaul".

4. ⚰️ Bereaved families are falling into debt as funeral costs outpace state aid
State help with funeral costs no longer covers even half a typical funeral director's fee, leaving families borrowing money or forgoing a service with mourners. MPs are set to discuss bereavement support.

5. 🏥 NHS launches world's largest trial of AI to spot breast cancer earlier
Researchers will test the technology in breast cancer screening, which could ease pressure on the NHS.

6. 🛒 Poundland has days to find a buyer or face administration
Poundland has a matter of days to find a buyer or it could collapse into administration.

7. ⚠️ Co-op Live evacuated after 'unknown substance' let off in crowd
One person was taken to hospital after a major incident was declared during a performance by US rapper Don Toliver at the Manchester venue.

8. ⚽ Fifa set to confirm UK as host of 2035 Women's World Cup
Fifa is set to confirm on Monday that the UK will host the 2035 Women's World Cup, the first football World Cup in the UK since 1966.

Sources: BBC, Guardian, BBC Sport. Stories summarised from UK media reports. Images: Pixabay.
